other_conditions: Unemployment must not be due to punishment for misconduct, superannuation, or voluntary retirement.
The Insured Person must have completed a minimum of two years of insurable employment before becoming unemployed.
The Insured Person must have contributed at least 78 days in each of the three consecutive contribution periods preceding the claim.
Aadhaar and bank account details must be linked with the ESIC database.
If the Insured Person works for more than one employer, unemployment is recognized only when they are unemployed with all employers.
The Insured Person cannot receive any other cash compensation under the ESI Act for the same period while claiming this relief.

Disqualifications include illegal lockout strikes, voluntary abandonment or retirement, less than two years of contributory service, attaining the age of superannuation, conviction under Section 84 of the ESI Act, re‑employment during the relief period, disciplinary dismissal, and death of the Insured Person.
benefits_summary: Provides cash compensation equal to 50% of the average daily earnings for up to 90 days of unemployment, subject to eligibility criteria.
documents_required: Cancelled cheque leaf or bank passbook (if bank details are not already in the ESIC database)
